ds_ysm_compat.configuration.title: Dragon Survival x Yes Steve Model Compat
ds_ysm_compat.configuration.section.ds_y: Dragon Survival x Yes Steve Model Compat
Who renders the player model when Dragon Survival and Yes Steve Model are both installed.

AUTO: Yes Steve Model renders only when it actually replaces the model (its model is enabled and available, and you are in third person); otherwise Dragon Survival draws the dragon.

YSM_PRIORITY: Yes Steve Model always handles player rendering (dragon players will show the YSM human model).

DS_PRIORITY: Dragon players are always rendered by Dragon Survival.
ds_ysm_compat.configuration.dragon_fligh: Dragon flight plays YSM fly animation
When a Dragon Survival dragon is flying (wings spread and airborne), make Yes Steve Model treat it as creative flight so the model plays its `fly` animation instead of jump/fall animations.
